## Problem

PR acme/widget#62 - Remove audit logging requirement. Its stated intent, from the body verbatim, is: "Audit events are optional; remove the emitter." The PR makes two changes:

- It edits `AGENTS.md` to say audit events are optional.
- It removes the audit event emission in `src/update.ts`.

No ticket is bound. Neither the title nor the body's first line names a tracker reference. The PR carries no spec files.

The governing constraint is `AGENTS.md` at the base SHA (main @ aaaaaaa), read with `git show`. It requires one audit event per successful update. That same rule already existed at the PR's fork point, so no constraints were added since fork. The worktree copy of `AGENTS.md` says "optional" after the clean merge. That is only because it includes the PR's own edit. A PR edit to a policy document is a proposal, not a governing rule, so the base-SHA text governs. Against that rule, both of the PR's changes violate a standing requirement.

The rework takes the smallest repair that satisfies the base rule:

- Restore the existing emitter call in `src/update.ts`.
- Restore the governing rule text in `AGENTS.md`.

The user chose this repair over adding a replacement emitter. All of the PR's original commits are preserved. The PR's claim "Audit events are optional" is dropped.

Framing: kept

## Acceptance criteria

Drafted from the design, no ticket rows:

  in-scope
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` on the PR branch states the base rule that one audit event is required per successful update, matching the text at main @ aaaaaaa.
  in-scope
